BaseballPitch.start: hold the baseball and position themselves on the pitcher's mound
BaseballPitch.middle: wind up, bringing their arm back for the pitch
BaseballPitch.end: release the ball towards home plate
BaseballPitch.glob: throw a baseball towards home plate from the pitcher's mound, using a combination of arm strength and technique to deliver the ball accurately and with sufficient speed for the batter to hit it

BasketballDunk.middle: jump and leap towards the hoop
BasketballDunk.end: slam the ball through the hoop
BasketballDunk.glob: jump high into the air and use their arms to propel themselves upwards, then extend their body towards the basketball hoop, grab the ball with one or both hands, and forcefully slam it through the net

Billiards.start: position themselves and the billiard cue stick near the cue ball
Billiards.middle: strike the cue ball with the cue stick, aiming for the desired target ball
Billiards.end: observe the outcome of the shot, adjusting their stance or strategy as needed
Billiards.glob: position themselves at the table, take aim at the cue ball, strike it with the cue stick, and then follow through to control the direction of the cue ball and the subsequent movement of the other balls on the table

CleanAndJerk.start: grip the barbell and lift it off the ground
CleanAndJerk.middle: drive the barbell upwards using their legs and hips while keeping their back straight
CleanAndJerk.end: catch the barbell overhead with fully extended arms and locked elbows
CleanAndJerk.glob: begin by lifting the barbell from the floor using an overhand grip and a wide stance, then drive it up to their chest while keeping their back straight and core engaged

CliffDiving.start: position themselves at the edge of the cliff, preparing for the dive
CliffDiving.middle: leap off the cliff, performing a series of flips and twists in mid-air
CliffDiving.end: enter the water with a splash, completing the dive
CliffDiving.glob: jump from a high cliff into the water below, often with a significant drop, demonstrating a combination of courage and skill

CricketBowling.start: hold the cricket ball and position themselves in the bowling crease
CricketBowling.middle: run up towards the pitch, swinging the arm back to build momentum for the delivery
CricketBowling.end: release the ball towards the batsman, aiming for the wicket
CricketBowling.glob: stand on one leg and swing their arm back, then bring it forward quickly to throw the ball towards the batsman

CricketShot.start: hold the bat and position themselves at the crease
CricketShot.middle: swing the bat to hit the ball
CricketShot.end: follow through with the swing and complete the shot
CricketShot.glob: hold the cricket bat with both hands, position themselves in a ready stance, and swing the bat to hit the ball

Diving.start: prepare and position themselves at the edge or surface of the water
Diving.middle: jump or dive off the starting point, propelling themselves into the air
Diving.end: enter the water, creating a splash upon impact
Diving.glob: jump from a platform or springboard into the water, extending their body and limbs to create a streamlined shape for optimal entry, and then enter the water with minimal splash

FrisbeeCatch.middle: extend their arms and position them to catch the Frisbee
FrisbeeCatch.end: successfully catch the Frisbee with their hands
FrisbeeCatch.glob: throw the Frisbee towards themselves and then extend their arms to catch it as it approaches

GolfSwing.start: take a stance and grip the club
GolfSwing.middle: swing the club back and rotate their body
GolfSwing.end: release the club and follow through with the swing
GolfSwing.glob: start by taking a stance with their feet shoulder-width apart and knees slightly bent, then they would swing the club back over their shoulder, keeping their body turned towards the target

HammerThrow.start: hold the hammer and rotate their body to build momentum
HammerThrow.middle: swing the hammer back over their head, rotating their body further to increase speed
HammerThrow.end: release the hammer and follow through with their motion, completing the throw
HammerThrow.glob: begin by holding the hammer throw ball with both hands, then swing it back over their head and around their body, building momentum

HighJump.start: begin by running up to the bar, gaining momentum
HighJump.middle: leap over the bar, clearing it with their body
HighJump.end: land safely on the mat below, completing the jump
HighJump.glob: run up to the bar, leap over it, and land on the mat

JavelinThrow.start: hold the javelin and prepare for the throw
JavelinThrow.middle: run up to the throwing line and swing the javelin back
JavelinThrow.end: release the javelin and follow through with their motion
JavelinThrow.glob: begin by running up to the throwing area, then they would plant their right foot and swing their left arm back over their head, building momentum

LongJump.start: begin by running up to the takeoff point
LongJump.middle: jump off the ground and extend their body forward
LongJump.end: land on the sand pit or mat
LongJump.glob: run up to the takeoff board, jump over it, and land on their feet after clearing the bar

PoleVault.start: begin by running up to the pole vault pit, gaining momentum
PoleVault.middle: plant the pole into the ground and use it to launch themselves upwards, clearing the bar
PoleVault.end: land safely on the mat after clearing the bar
PoleVault.glob: run up to the pole vault pit, plant their pole into the box at the end of the runway, and use the pole to launch themselves over the bar

Shotput.start: hold the shotput firmly and position themselves in a ready stance
Shotput.middle: swing their arm back and rotate their body to build momentum
Shotput.end: release the shotput with a powerful throw, following through with their motion
Shotput.glob: stand with feet shoulder-width apart, hold the shotput in both hands, and then swing their arms back, rotating their body to build momentum

SoccerPenalty.start: position themselves at the penalty spot and take a few steps back to prepare for the kick
SoccerPenalty.middle: run towards the ball and strike it with their foot, aiming for the goal
SoccerPenalty.end: follow through with their kick and watch the ball's trajectory towards the goalpost
SoccerPenalty.glob: stand at the penalty spot, take a few steps back, and then kick the ball into the goal

TennisSwing.start: hold the racket and position themselves for the swing
TennisSwing.middle: initiate the swing, rotating their body and arm to generate power
TennisSwing.end: follow through with the swing, releasing the racket and completing the motion
TennisSwing.glob: start by holding the tennis racket with both hands, positioning it behind their head, and then swing forward with their body rotating to generate power

ThrowDiscus.start: hold the discus securely and position themselves for the throw
ThrowDiscus.middle: rotate their body and swing the discus back, building momentum
ThrowDiscus.end: release the discus with a powerful throw, following through with their motion
ThrowDiscus.glob: first hold the discus with both hands at shoulder height, then rotate their body to build momentum, and finally throw the discus forward with an explosive motion, using their entire body for power

VolleyballSpiking.start: position themselves and prepare for the spike
VolleyballSpiking.middle: jump and make contact with the ball
VolleyballSpiking.end: follow through with the spike, aiming to send the ball over the net
VolleyballSpiking.glob: approach the net, jump, and strike the volleyball with their dominant hand, aiming for the opposing team's court
